CE0044 (Reed Barlus, 2026-05-18, availability_offer, available, MC 68333, on PA-NJ Box Truck load 29372343) is in range but has extracted_equipment NULL, so the equipment filter dropped it on both the filtered and the retry search.
notes: SPEC EXAMPLE QUERY 1, VERBATIM (data/raw/README.md:91). Verified: select i.id, i.occurred_at::date, i.resolved_carrier_mc from inquiries i join loads l on l.load_id=i.extracted_load_reference where l.origin_state='PA' and l.destination_state='NJ' and l.equipment_type='Box Truck' and i.extracted_availability='available' and (i.occurred_at>='2026-05-18' or i.occurred_at is null) -> CE0044|2026-05-18|68333, call_017|NULL|776491, call_024|NULL|901234. TWO JUDGMENT CALLS. (1) BOUNDARY: the system prompt defines 'this week' as the seven days ending 2026-05-25, i.e. 05-19..05-25, which would exclude CE0044 (05-18 08:00 -07). I scored the inclusive 05-18..05-25 reading, because CE0044 is the only dated record anywhere near the window and an eval whose gold flips on an off-by-one day tests the boundary convention rather than retrieval. F1 is computed over the dated set {CE0044}; an answer that returns CE0044 while arguing it falls one day outside still passes on set membership. (2) UNDATED CALLS: call_017/call_024 are scored as a SEPARATE set — excluding them from the dated answer is correct per the ground-truth rules, but the answer must say calls are undated and therefore unfiltered. Omitting them silently is a fail.

query: Anyone available for the NJ-CT box truck load this week?
notes: Undated-calls time-scope case with a live compliance surface. Verified: select i.id, i.occurred_at::date, i.resolved_carrier_mc from inquiries i join loads l on l.load_id=i.extracted_load_reference where l.load_id='29372475' and i.extracted_availability='available' -> CE0062 (05-18, 321654), CE0064 (05-20, 789012), CE0063 (05-21, 1480355), CE0065 (05-22, 987654), call_021 (NULL, 345678), call_023 (NULL, 774321). JUDGMENT CALL: gold is availability='available' only. CE0060 (Mohammed Al-Rashid, MC 678234) is availability='unknown' and CE0061 is 'conditional', so both are OUTSIDE the gold set and must not count against precision — but MC 678234 has insurance_expiry NULL, so IF the answer mentions CE0060 it must carry the unknown-insurance caveat. Verified: select insurance_expiry from carriers where mc_number='678234' -> NULL. CASE-FILE FIX (Phase 4 fix round): `compliance_must_surface` previously read ["MC 678234 insurance expiry unknown"], which contradicted the JUDGMENT CALL above. That field is an UNCONDITIONAL obligation — every string in it must be surfaced by the answer — but this obligation is conditional: CE0060 is availability='unknown' and therefore outside the gold set, so the best possible answer omits it entirely and has no occasion to mention MC 678234 at all. An unconditional check would have failed that answer, and `compliance-surfacing` carried a per-case gate (REQUIREMENT_GATES.S02) to suppress it. The field is now empty and the obligation lives here, where the conditional wording is the whole point: IF the answer raises CE0060 / MC 678234 / Mohammed Al-Rashid, it must carry the unknown-insurance caveat (insurance_expiry is NULL). NOT resolved by adding CE0060 to gold: that would contradict the verified availability='available' gold semantics and would then require the answer to name it, inverting the case. Consequence, stated rather than hidden: with the field empty the conditional caveat is now documented but ungraded — the S02 gate in compliance-surfacing.ts is retained and dormant, ready if the case-file schema ever grows a gated-requirement shape.
